summary: PR #440 (an inconclusive archive lsof probe no longer turns a valid snapshot restore into quiescence_unproven; the CI flake in PR 426 r13 shared-lifetime). Author lane on studio4 (r1, 48b9ec99) located the refusal at openExclusive's archive handle probe and added a bounded, fail-closed retry with a value-free diagnostic. Review r1 (studio1) REQUEST_CHANGES: P1 the retry sat in the shared opener and could stall ordinary startup past its 10-second budget; P2 allowlist the diagnostic code. The lead's 5fe85c96 limits the retry to lifecycle opens (restore, discard, quiesce) and keeps one probe for every ordinary open; 1ef03b2b checks that at openLedgerDatabase. Review r2 APPROVEs 1ef03b2b: the r1 P1 is closed, real foreign handles still refuse, lifecycle retries stay bounded; one worker-only P2 filed.
